source.license: Public domain, explicitly stated for these three datasets on the supplied source page
source.word_transform: Pure Han 2-8 characters with existing codes; at most eight exact Quick code variants, two-code roots first; weight=max(10,min(3000,30*observed_count)); existing stronger weights retained; fourth column preserves observed corpus count for independent bounded phrase evidence
source.corpus_evidence_transform: For observed 2-4 character words, evidence=.75*(length-1)*min(1,log(1+count)/log(301)) at the completed suffix across token boundaries; fuse with existing phrase evidence using max, not sum, to avoid double-counting overlapping corpora; duplicate code variants use max; existing combined lexical evidence cap of 4 per character retained
source.character_transform: Normalize corpus counts to existing overlapping character total; 15% log blend, per-character ratio limited to [1/1.3,1.3]; absent counts leave original weights unchanged; HK-common runtime floor retained
limitations: Word occurrences are counted without segmentation; overlapping words may be double-counted.
Words missing from the corpus have no measured frequency, not zero validity.
No article bodies, full dictionary definitions/examples, personal text, or evaluation sentences imported.
Jyutping is not a Cangjie/Quick code source; existing character codes alone supply every imported code.

validation.input_source: Reproduced with tools/build_ranking_cases.py and the pinned HKCanCor ZIP; validation.tsv

fresh.input_source: Reproduced with tools/build_ranking_cases.py and the pinned HKCanCor ZIP; heldout.tsv

additive_corpus_evidence.note: Same suffix evidence must not be double-counted across overlapping corpora. Additive .75 model failed existing bicycle sentence regression; weight 1.5 also lowered validation top1 from 122 to 119. Replaced by max evidence fusion, preserving stronger existing priors.

learning_simulation.method: Actual SingleSelectionHistory and PhraseLearning, three explicit selection passes over 32 authored daily cases; legacy and contextual arms share identical legacy records within this release.
learning_simulation.limitation: Replayed selected sentences measure personalization, not unseen sentence generalization.

validation.latency_rerun_note: An initial run overlapped eight JVM ranking evaluations and exceeded the existing five-second assertion. Full suite rerun without ranking workload passed with the original assertion unchanged.
validation.existing_loading_benchmark_script: Passed; javac sourcepath resolves the contextual learning engine dependencies.

limits: Small aggregate ranking gain; no universal sentence correctness classifier or guarantee of first-place user intent.

Validation cases (240) participate in the 600-case aggregate and are reported separately; old held-out 120 and additional held-out 240 were evaluated only after max evidence fusion was chosen on validation and regressions.
Authored daily cases did not gain top1 or top5; some wanted sentences moved down.
Written corpus frequency is counted without segmentation and is not contemporary HK chat frequency.
No article bodies, definitions/examples, full private sentences or evaluation sentences were imported into vocabulary/model.
No Fold7 device measurement or Android latency measurement in this release.
evaluation_method: Actual DictionaryEngine, QuickDecoder and OfflineLanguageModel on fixed cases with empty personal history. Each emitted candidate is checked against every typed Quick code. Identical cases in both arms, before any data/code changes versus final max evidence fusion. No language-model retraining.

reproduce.ranking: Compile actual plain Java engine classes and tools/RankingEvaluation.java, then java -Xmx1g -cp <classes> hk.kaiboard.android.RankingEvaluation <assets> <cases.tsv> <output.tsv>
reproduce.baseline: Use baseline commit for both engine classes and assets; keep generated evaluation inputs identical.

loading_and_heap.method: Three separate JVMs per arm, Java 17 -Xms256m -Xmx512m, baseline commit engine plus baseline character/phrase assets vs final engine/assets. No concurrent ranking jobs or unit suite. LoadingBenchmark accepts an asset directory.
